title: ci: run main's full battery every 4 hours and CodeQL daily (maintainer ruling Q6 = C)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DVbbHyHMZtUJMt5EUYKRYE5)_

Fixes #25771

Maintainer ruling Q6 = C: the scheduled full battery of `CI` and `Lint & Type Check` runs every 4 hours instead of hourly, and CodeQL runs daily instead of on every push to `main`. Job logic is unchanged: the scheduled run is still the full battery. Dropping the push-to-main CI/Lint runs is out of scope, per the card.

## The change

- `ci.yml`, `lint.yml`: `on.schedule` `'0 * * * *'` → `'0 */4 * * *'`. `workflow_dispatch` kept.
- `codeql.yml`: `push: main` dropped; schedule `'0 2 * * 1'` (Monday deep pass) → `'0 2 * * *'` (daily, same query suite, so the Monday pass folds in); `workflow_dispatch` added so a fix can be re-analyzed on demand.

## The scheduled-full-run card identity (the part that is not S)

**Choice: the identity moves to the new cadence, and the hourly spellings stay readable.** `CARD_CADENCES` names `4-hourly` for both workflows, so a newly filed card is titled `4-hourly full run: red on main (CI)` with marker `os-4-hourly-full-run-ci`, and its body says "every 4 hours". A new `CADENCE_PREDECESSORS` map (`'4-hourly': ['hourly']`) gives each identity a `legacy` title and marker that `matchesCard` still reads. So the open card #25438 (`hourly full run: red on main (CI)` / `os-hourly-full-run-ci`) is found by its old title or old marker, refreshed in place, and never duplicated. A refresh rewrites the body with the current marker and leaves the title alone (`updateIssue` writes only the body). A legacy spelling is read, never filed.

Pinned in `scheduled-full-run.mjs --self-test` (card identity battery floor 34 → 42):
- #25438's real title and real first body line are found by title, and by marker alone after a rename;
- a red 4-hourly run refreshes #25438, files no second card, and leaves the current marker in the body (found by that afterwards too);
- an empty board files under the new title, not the legacy one;
- Lint's identity does not match CI's hourly card;
- each watched workflow declares exactly `'0 */4 * * *'`, so the cadence on the card is the cadence the workflow runs.

Mutation checks: emptying `CADENCE_PREDECESSORS` reds the self-test ("#25438 would be orphaned"); reverting `lint.yml` to `'0 * * * *'` reds it too.

## Readers of the cadence

- **Release gate** (`--release-gate`, `releaseGateVerdict`): no clock anywhere in it. It reads the nearest completed `schedule` or `push` run at or before the version commit, so nothing reads a 4-hour gap as missing. The window constants (400 commits, 3 × 100 runs) cover 50 days of scheduled runs. `docs/releases-maintenance.md` now says that a version commit can wait up to 4 hours for its first scheduled full run, that the gate does not wait for it (the version commit's own push run usually decides), and when a dispatched run helps.
- **Shard-timings refresh**: the weekly lane accumulates scheduled runs whose `test-core-run-summary-*` / `test-core-timings-*` artifacts are still downloadable. With 1-day retention, hourly gave 24 of them; at every 4 hours it would give 6. The two uploads now use `retention-days: ${{ github.event_name == 'schedule' && 4 || 1 }}`, which keeps about 24 in the window and leaves every other event at 1 day. This is the one change outside "cron + words"; drop it if the reviewer prefers fewer samples to longer retention. The `PREVIOUS_FILE_SHARDED_PACKAGES` comment in `partition-test-shards.mjs` follows the new window.
- Prose and messages that said "hourly" in `ci.yml`, `lint.yml`, `release.yml`, `scheduled-full-run-card.yml` (job display name included), `shard-timings-refresh.yml`, `select-shard-timings-run.mjs`, `select-gate-families.sh`, `select-shard-packages.sh`, their self-test case names, and one `AGENTS.md` sentence. The lint step `Hourly full run self-test and concurrency gate` was renamed `Scheduled full run …` (id too; nothing else reads it). Historical measurements that describe the hourly era are left as written.

## Verification

- `node scripts/ci/scheduled-full-run.mjs --self-test` OK; `--check-concurrency` OK for both files.
- `select-shard-timings-run.mjs --self-test`, `partition-test-shards.mjs --self-test`, `select-gate-families.selftest.sh` (59 cases), `select-shard-packages.selftest.sh` (32 cases) all pass.
- `grep -n cron .github/workflows/ci.yml .github/workflows/lint.yml .github/workflows/codeql.yml` → `'0 */4 * * *'`, `'0 */4 * * *'`, `'0 2 * * *'`.
- Derived gate families (`dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, 82 commands on the pre-merge tree): 77 exit 0. 5 exit 3 (NOT MEASURED, they need every package's `dist/`): `check:doc-formula-expressions`, `check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`, `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content`. CI's lanes own those.

Tier H (`.github/workflows/**`): lands after a GOVERNED_APPROVERS approval.
